A small [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] was located in the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] traversed it to reach their [[Crustai asteroid base|Crustai base]] of [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] that was inside a large, wobbly [[Unidentified asteroid (Crustai system)|asteroid]] in the asteroid field.<ref name="OBF" />
